ceremony_status.description: The outcome of the passkey registration/authentication ceremony. In the context of a passkey registration ceremony, it starts when the 'Create a new passkey' webcard is displayed and ends as soon as the user cancels the suggestion, encounters an error or successfully register a new passkey. A passkey authentication ceremony starts when the user is suggested to log in with a passkey and ends as soon as the user cancels the suggestion, encounters an error or successfully logs in with a new passkey

attempt_count.description: Attempt number in user verification flow or similar process.

authentication_mediation_type.description: The way passkeys have been suggested to the user to login on an account (multiple items webcard, automatic login notification, etc.)

is_registered_with_dashlane.description: If the user chose to register the passkey with Dashlane

is_authenticated_with_dashlane.description: If the user chose to login with a passkey registered in Dashlane

passkey_registration_error_type.description: Type of passkey registration errors that Dashlane throws when a request is not valid

passkey_authentication_error_type.description: Type of passkey authentication errors that Dashlane throws when a request is not valid

passkey_type.description: Type of passkey created or used for authentication

ms_to_complete_registration.description: Time taken by the user to register a passkey

ms_to_complete_authentication.description: Time taken by the user to authentication with a passkey

ms_to_complete_registration_timeout.description: Maximum amount of time allowed to complete the passkey registration ceremony

ms_to_complete_authentication_timeout.description: Maximum amount of time allowed to complete the passkey authentication ceremony

algorithms_supported.description: Encryption algorithm supported by the website

algorithms_supported_list.description: List of encryption algorithms supported by the website

webauthn_extension_supported_list.description: List of extensions supported by the authenticator

authenticator_attachment.description: Eligible authenticator. The value “platform” indicates a platform authenticator, such as Windows Hello. The “cross-platform“, value indicates a roaming authenticator, such as a security key.

authenticator_resident_key.description: The private key and associated metadata is stored in persistent memory on the authenticator, instead of encrypted and stored on the relying party server

authenticator_user_verification.description: The authenticator verifies that the user is authorized to use the authenticator, and signals to the Relying Party (organization responsible for registering and authenticating the user) whether user verification was successful

authenticator_user_verification_source.description: For when user verification is made, indicates the source.
